items.title: Kelly Clarkson says a Brooklyn shop treated her like "Pretty Woman"
items.summary: Kelly Clarkson said Brooklyn shop Art of Play acted like she couldn't afford anything. The store later said the piece she wanted wasn't for sale, and she answered with a $15,000 price tag: "you're also a liar."
items.author: @kellyclarkson

post.name: Kelly Clarkson
post.text: Just drove all the way to Brooklyn to check out this store I thought looked really rad and had a few things in mind to buy and literally was looked at as if I couldn’t afford it and was told he could find something comparable for me. Wow, dude. You’re an idiot and just lost a
